transcript.text: Hi everyone. Before I make any final decision about painting the hand-lettered sign on the café's storefront, I want to do my customary final check. Could each person present please state any relevant offer, pricing, scope, scheduling, or site requirement you have in mind? I need to hear all of that before I commit to anything.
